Definition: from the base of G5530 or G5534; employment, i.e. an affair; also (by implication) occasion, demand, requirement or destitution:--business, lack, necessary(-ity), need(-ful), use, want.
BiblicalUsage: Need is the word for what a person lacks, and John the Baptist says he has need to be baptized by Jesus instead. Jesus says the sick have need of a physician, and John says Jesus has no need to be told what is in a man. The word runs from a felt lack to the One who knows every lack without being told.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe need is where the gospel begins, because only people who know they lack something come to be filled. Jesus does not wait to be told our need; He already knows it, and He meets it. My position is that admitting need is not weakness — it is the door to grace.
